data.content_ref: inline:The proposed relation is a false reduction. A reduction must preserve the output of the target it reduces to (the standard piecewise mechanism), but SRC_001's uniform-rate transformation yields $1,269 whereas the standard piecewise calculation yields $1,251 (40×$18 + 7×$27). Applying the premium rate to all 47 hours is not a simplification of the two-band mechanism—it fundamentally changes the base-band rate from $18 to $27, producing a numerically different result. Calling this a 'reduction' conflates 'simpler to compute' with 'reduces to'; the relation is actually a modification, not a reduction. The target even undercuts itself: the refutation clause asks whether $1,269 can be described as a simplification or reduction of the standard piecewise mechanism, and since it changes the base-band price, it cannot.
